item.title: 50th Anniversary Meeting Street Telethon raises over $700K
item.description: The 50th Annual Meeting Street Telethon proved again that a community can come together on a cold winter night to support the one-of-a-kind school, raising $717,645 for the local non-profit.

item.title: Crews respond to 2-alarm fire in Glocester
item.description: GLOCESTER, R.I. (WPRI) -- Crews in Glocester were called to a 2-alarm garage fire early Sunday morning.
